title: Add Hosted API model rollout canary job + docs
author: Dev Patel
description:
Context: Platform oncall has been starting ad-hoc canary comparisons during Hosted API model rollouts, but the job setup varies by driver and the resulting output is hard to compare across rollouts. This PR adds a standard canary job template (route-scoped) and a short operator guide that links to the rollout runbook and SRE gates doc.

Changes:
- Add canary job template `jobs/hosted_api_rollout_canary.yaml` that runs A/B comparisons between stable and candidate model versions for a route
- Emit standard metrics: success_rate_delta, p95_latency_delta, ttft_delta, streaming_disconnect_delta
- Add docs: `docs/hosted-api-canary-tooling-guide.md` with instructions for start/stop and required parameters

Operator notes:
- Job requires route name, stable version ID, candidate version ID, and minimum window duration
- Defaults align with SRE gate minimums; overriding requires SRE approval

Checklist:
- [x] Added dashboard links in doc
- [x] Added runbook references
- [x] Added CI job to validate YAML schema

Commits (summary):
1) add hosted rollout canary job template
2) emit standard comparison metrics
3) docs: operator guide + examples

Files changed (high-level):
- jobs/hosted_api_rollout_canary.yaml
- docs/hosted-api-canary-tooling-guide.md
- src/metrics/comparison.py
- .github/workflows/validate_jobs.yml
